intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has pinned up a hand-lettered notice: *PLEASE DO NOT TUOCH.*

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri’s ears go up. She opens her mouth, glances at you, and closes it again.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I have a joke about that sign. A good one.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’ve been holding it for a full minute. It’s getting heavy.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I’m practicing being a princess who can walk past a typo. It’s agony.”

options.labelText: “Walking past it is optional. Tell me the joke.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Right. Whoever wrote this sign has clearly never been tuoched by greatness.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: It’s terrible. You laugh anyway, properly, and she looks as if she has won something.

options.labelText: “You don’t have to be funny with me, you know.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks past the sign. The joke stays where it is, unspent.
